uncertain_points.claim: The comment intends that key_expand_prd_we is asserted only when key data (key_full_q) is valid, but the assignment only depends on key_full_we being SP2V_HIGH. security_implications: This chunk connects the key expansion instance (aes_key_expand) and generates its prd_we signal. The PRD (pseudo‑random data for masking) is written into the key expansion module whenever key_full_we is asserted (equals SP2V_HIGH). If that signal is mis‑timed relative to the actual key data (key_full_q), the masking update may be out of sync, creating a window where internal S‑Box masked values are inconsistent. This could compromise the side‑channel countermeasure and expose secret key material. The key expansion outputs (key_expand_out, key_expand_err) also carry security‑sensitive data and error flags.
